---
title: "health facility Map"
output: html_document
---

```{r}



knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)


if(!require(pacman)) install.packages("pacman")

p_load(
  tidyverse,
  here,
  summarytools,
  janitor,
  sf, 
  tmap,
  OpenStreetMap,
  flextable,
  rio, 
  gtsummary, 
  epikit
)
```


```{r}
# health facilit

hf_map<-import(here(
  "data",
  "MHFR_Facilities.xlsx"
)) |> 
  clean_names() |> 
  filter(status=="Functional") |> 
  select(
    common_name, 
    latitude,
    longitude
     ) |> 
   drop_na() %>% 
  sf::st_as_sf(coords = c("longitude",  "latitude"), crs = 4326) 


```


```{r}

tmap_mode("view")


tm_shape(hf_map) + 
  tm_dots(
    col = "common_name", 
    size = 0.1, 
    palette = "Set1", 
    title = "Health Facility",
    id = "common_name"
  ) +
  tm_basemap(server = "OpenStreetMap") +
  tm_layout(
    title = "Health Facilities in Malawi",
    title.position = c("left", "top"),
    legend.outside = TRUE
  )



```
